title: "fire a focus event" expects an element as argument, but is called with a Window

labels.name: interop
labels.description: Implementations are not interoperable with each other

body:
### What is the issue with the HTML Standard?

> To **fire a focus event** named e at an _element_ t with a given related target r, [fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named e at t, using [FocusEvent](https://w3c.github.io/uievents/#focusevent), with the [relatedTarget](https://w3c.github.io/uievents/#dom-focusevent-relatedtarget) attribute initialized to r, the [view](https://w3c.github.io/uievents/#dom-uievent-view) attribute initialized to t's [node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)'s [relevant global object](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#concept-relevant-global), and the [composed flag](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#composed-flag) set.

but in the [focus update steps](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/interaction.html#focus-update-steps), we get

> 2. If entry is an element, let blur event target be entry.
>     If entry is a [Document](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/dom.html#document) object, let blur event target be that [Document](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/dom.html#document) object's [relevant global object](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#concept-relevant-global).
>     Otherwise, let blur event target be null.
> 3. ...
> 4. If blur event target is not null, [fire a focus event](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/interaction.html#fire-a-focus-event) named [blur](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/indices.html#event-blur) at blur event target, with related blur target as the related target.

and similar for "focus". The relevant global object will not be an element.
